_passReveal.title: Pass Reveal
_passReveal.description: Enables model answer display on assessment questions only after the learner passes

_isEnabled.title: Enable pass reveal
_isEnabled.description: When true, model answers are revealed only after passing an assessment. When false or absent, the extension does nothing.

_assessmentIds.title: Assessment IDs
_assessmentIds.description: Optional array of assessment IDs to apply pass-reveal to. If empty or absent, applies to all assessments.
